### 关键改动

1. **卸载**：`@xterm/xterm@6`、`@xterm/addon-fit`、`@xterm/addon-webgl`
2. **安装**：`@xterm/xterm@5`、`@xterm/addon-fit@0.10.0`、`@xterm/addon-canvas@0.7.0`
3. **代码**：移除 WebGL 导入，使用动态导入 Canvas addon
